gloss: anemia; dizziness from lack of blood

definitions.gloss: anemia; deficiency of red blood cells
definitions.explanation: A medical condition where the blood has fewer red blood cells than normal, causing fatigue and weakness.
In everyday usage, often refers to feeling faint or dizzy, especially when standing up quickly (orthostatic hypotension).

examples.japanese: {貧血|ひんけつ}と{診断|しんだん}された。
{鉄分|てつぶん}{不足|ふそく}で{貧血|ひんけつ}になった。
examples.english: I became anemic due to iron deficiency.

examples.japanese: {貧血|ひんけつ}の{症状|しょうじょう}には{疲|つか}れやすさがある。
examples.english: Symptoms of anemia include feeling easily fatigued.

examples.japanese: {貧血|ひんけつ}を{起|お}こした。
{急|きゅう}に{立|た}ち{上|あ}がったら{貧血|ひんけつ}で{倒|たお}れそうになった。
examples.english: When I stood up quickly, I nearly fainted from dizziness.

examples.japanese: {朝礼|ちょうれい}で{長|なが}く{立|た}っていたら{貧血|ひんけつ}を{起|お}こして{座|すわ}り{込|こ}んでしまった。
examples.english: I got dizzy from standing for a long time at the morning assembly and had to sit down.

notes:
FORMATION:
{貧|ひん} (poor/lacking) + {血|けつ} (blood)

Literally 'poor blood.'

COLLOCATIONS:
・{貧血|ひんけつ}になる - to become anemic
・{貧血|ひんけつ}を{起|お}こす - to have a dizzy spell
・{貧血|ひんけつ}ぎみ - slightly anemic
・{鉄欠乏性|てつけつぼうせい}{貧血|ひんけつ} - iron deficiency anemia

MEDICAL NOTE:
Medically, {貧血|ひんけつ} refers specifically to anemia. In everyday conversation, people often use {貧血|ひんけつ} to describe orthostatic hypotension ({起立性|きりつせい}{低血圧|ていけつあつ}), which is technically different.
